display.purpose: Headings and marketing display in Source Serif 4.

body.purpose: All interface text in Public Sans at 1rem, line-height 1.55.

mono.purpose: Moves, clocks, coordinates, and evaluations in IBM Plex Mono.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single filled action. Terracotta fill, white text, 44px target.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: var(--kanso-font-ui); background: var(--kanso-color-action-primary-default); color: var(--kanso-color-text-on-accent); border: none; border-radius: var(--kanso-radius-control); min-height: 44px; padding: 0 1rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--kanso-color-action-primary-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--kanso-color-focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Raised background, strong border, teal focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-field-label { font-family: var(--kanso-font-ui); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--kanso-color-text-primary); } .ds-input { font-family: var(--kanso-font-ui); min-height: 44px; width: 100%; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; background: var(--kanso-color-surface-raised); color: var(--kanso-color-text-primary); border: 1px solid var(--kanso-color-border-strong); border-radius: var(--kanso-radius-control); font-size: 1rem; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--kanso-color-focus-ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--kanso-color-focus-ring); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--kanso-color-text-muted); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Raised paper surface, lg radius, no shadow.
components.html:
Sign in

Body text sits on raised paper.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--kanso-color-surface-raised); border-radius: var(--kanso-radius-surface); padding: 1rem; color: var(--kanso-color-text-primary); } .ds-card-title { font-family: var(--kanso-font-display); font-size: 1.375rem; line-height: 1.2; margin: 0 0 0.5rem; } .ds-card-body { font-family: var(--kanso-font-ui); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--kanso-color-text-muted); margin: 0; }

components.name: Link
components.description: Action hue with an underline as the second channel.
components.css: .ds-link { font-family: var(--kanso-font-ui); color: var(--kanso-color-link); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.15em; min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; } .ds-link:hover { color: var(--kanso-color-action-primary-hover); } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--kanso-color-focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Message
components.description: Success and error states, each with an icon so hue is never the only channel.
components.html:
Account created.

Email or password was not accepted.
components.css: .ds-status { font-family: var(--kanso-font-ui); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.55; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; margin: 0; } .ds-status svg { flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-status-success { color: var(--kanso-color-success); } .ds-status-error { color: var(--kanso-color-danger); }

components.name: App Header
components.description: Wordmark in display type under a hairline bottom border.
components.css: .ds-header { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--kanso-color-border-subtle); } .ds-wordmark { font-family: var(--kanso-font-display); font-size: 1.375rem; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--kanso-color-text-primary); margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: Kanso Chess looks like serious study, not a game. The light theme is a warm study: paper neutrals, printed-book typography, and one terracotta accent, credible to a coach and aspirational to a twelve-year-old competitor. The dark theme, Rapid, is the same study after dark: cool slate surfaces and a periwinkle accent, because serious young players live in dark mode and a light-toned board stays the obvious focal point there. The interface is calm and uncluttered. One action accent per theme, used sparingly. Depth comes from three steps of brightness, never drop shadows. The board is always the brightest object on the screen; the interface recedes so the position reads at a glance. This is the anti-game-portal: no saturated neon, no gamified candy, no red-green status pairs. Every state carries its meaning in at least two channels, never hue alone.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper light theme (Study Room) and cool slate dark theme (Rapid); a third high-contrast theme reaches WCAG AAA.
Print typography: Source Serif 4 display over Public Sans interface, with IBM Plex Mono for anything tabular.
One action accent per theme, scarce by design.
Flat tonal depth: brightness steps, no drop shadows.
The board is the brightest object on every screen.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: One action accent per theme, used on no more than a tenth of any screen. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Never-Next-to-Green Rule
rules.body: The action accent is never placed adjacent to green, so the pair cannot read as a flag or trip red-green deficiency.

rules.name: The Board Brightest Rule
rules.body: Page surfaces stay a step duller than any board theme. The board is the brightest object on every screen.

rules.name: The No Hue Alone Rule
rules.body: Meaning never travels by hue alone. Every state carries a second channel: an icon, an outline, a border, or a label.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Anything that must line up, digit over digit, uses IBM Plex Mono: moves, clocks, coordinates, evaluations.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Depth is conveyed by the three brightness steps, never by drop shadows.

dos: Do keep one action accent per theme, used on a tenth or less of any screen.
Do keep the board the brightest object; page surfaces stay a step duller.
Do pair every status color with a second channel: icon, outline, border, or label.
Do use md radius for controls and lg for cards.
Do use IBM Plex Mono for moves, clocks, coordinates, and evaluations.
Do hold muted text at 7:1 or better; body line-height at 1.55 or better.
Do target 44px for primary buttons and board squares.
donts: Don't place the action accent next to green.
Don't use red-to-green on the evaluation bar; it is white and black with a numeric label.
Don't encode meaning by hue alone.
Don't add drop shadows; depth is the three brightness steps.
Don't introduce a fourth font family; display, interface, and mono are fixed.
Don't let the interface outshine the board.
